title: travel!digital — corpus of travel accounts (Kontextualisierung von Reiseberichten)
institution: Austrian Centre for Digital Humanities and Cultural Heritage (ACDH), Austrian Academy of Sciences
notes:
Full-text corpus of travel accounts with linguistic and semantic mark-up, a documented TEI schema, and digital facsimiles of all volumes, archived in ARCHE (digitale-edition.at). Uncertainties: the exact period coverage (whether the majority of the corpus falls within 1450–1700) and the current project website were not verified — the ARCHE collection page blocked automated reading — and the language composition of the travel accounts may go beyond German. Verify scope before cataloguing.

Justification: An ACDH corpus project providing TEI-encoded, linguistically annotated full text of early modern travel literature together with facsimiles; found via a re3data/DARIAH-oriented web search. Not in the catalogue (the catalogue lists ABaC:us from the same institute, which is a different project).
Found at: https://www.digitale-edition.at/archive/objects/o:konde.p18/datastreams/TEI_SOURCE/content
